The firm can send letters of protection to providers when appropriate. Clients should forward any collections notices to their paralegal promptly.

Health insurers may have a right to reimbursement from the recovery, and the firm negotiates those amounts. Clients should talk to their doctor, not the firm, about any change in treatment.

Rental car coverage depends on the policies involved. Clients should photograph damage and keep repair estimates and invoices.

Storage fees at body shops can accumulate quickly, so delays should be avoided.

22. Knowledge base: Medical bills during an open claim (KB-273)
Clients should generally continue using their own health insurance for treatment while a claim is pending. Some providers will treat on a lien, meaning they are paid from the eventual recovery.

The firm can send letters of protection to providers when appropriate. Clients should forward any collections notices to their paralegal promptly.

Health insurers may have a right to reimbursement from the recovery, and the firm negotiates those amounts. Clients should talk to their doctor, not the firm, about any change in treatment.

23. Knowledge base: Property damage claims (KB-655)
Property damage is usually handled separately from the injury claim and often resolves sooner. Clients may use their own collision coverage and seek reimbursement of the deductible.

Rental car coverage depends on the policies involved. Clients should photograph damage and keep repair estimates and invoices.

Storage fees at body shops can accumulate quickly, so delays should be avoided.
